name: codex-push-hooks
description: Tiered push notifications for Reasonix — macOS, Bark, Telegram, Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, Pushover, ntfy, Gotify

Notification.description: Push a notification when tool approval or user attention is needed

Stop.description: Push a task-completion notification when a conversation turn ends

UserPromptSubmit.description: Cancel queued pushes once the user responds

PreToolUse.description: Before a tool runs: ask triggers a waiting-for-reply notification, other tools clear pending

PostToolUse.description: Clear the user_input pending marker after the question tool returns
